issue_request: FHIR-8548 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 FHIR-core extensibility issue asking to allow modifier extensions inside complex extensions; the final resolution allowed complex extension components to be marked isModifier and conveyed using extension rather than modifierExtension.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by commit fb014f678bbc94e0498ec1d5424cf7cfde9e6848, whose subject references #8548 and whose git-svn revision matches the Jira comment.
additional_context: FHIR-8548 directly superseded the temporary FHIR-8549 tooling rejection. Later related decisions FHIR-11036, FHIR-18352, and FHIR-37903 refined the current wording and already have combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. source/extensibility.html is active for Extension guidance and already states that complex extension parts can be Is-Modifier=true, are represented using extension rather than modifierExtension, and cannot include is-modifier elements not defined as part of the extension definition.
